invariant.source: In 1989, NASA's Voyager 2 became the first-and only-spacecraft to study Neptune up close.
invariant.relation: An encounter no other spacecraft has repeated

candidates: The story is about the singularity of Voyager 2’s close-up study of Neptune: in 1989, it became the first—and, according to the supplied material, the only—spacecraft to study the planet up close. The reader should understand that this encounter has not been repeated by another spacecraft.
- **Context:** Establish Neptune as the subject and focus on spacecraft study of the planet up close.
- **Development:** Identify Voyager 2 and 1989 as the spacecraft and year of the close-up study.
